# Pham Thanh Lam (Laam)

> Building AI systems that ship at scale

## Overview

Chief Data Science & AI Officer at Cake by VPBank, Vietnam's largest digital bank. Managing 15+ people running 100+ AI models and 150+ voice agents in production. Based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

## Current Work

Transforming traditional banking into agentic AI operations. Building toward unicorn status through:
- Digital twins and multi-agent systems handling real customer money
- Causal inference in production environments
- Revenue forecasting with Monte Carlo methods
- Personal AI Infrastructure (PAI) systems

## Background

- **2024-Present**: Chief Data Science & AI Officer, Cake by VPBank
  - 100+ AI models in production
  - 150+ voice agents deployed
  - Agentic banking infrastructure

- **2019-2023**: Vietnam's First Tech Unicorn
  - Built AI products: $1M+ ARR, 10M+ users (B2B2C)
  - Scaled systems under high-stakes production

- **2020**: IFC World Bank FIDN Keynote
  - Digital identity platforms at banking scale

- **2019**: WSDM Analytics Cup Winner
  - Fake news detection with modified BERT

## Philosophy

Systems that work at scale. Code that ships beats papers that don't. Agentic workflows replacing human ops. Causal inference in production, not just notebooks. Building tools that multiply force—Unix philosophy for AI systems.
